_note: Each dungeon boss's spoken lines: p2 when it takes control of the arena, p3 at the catastrophe, p4 at its final form, death as it falls. tools/voice/record.js --set bosses records them to audio/bosses/<boss>_<line>.mp3 and src/js/late/99-zzzzzzzzz-t9-boss-voice.js. voice: a Kokoro voice id. lift: pitch by resampling, below 1 is deeper.

sentinel_p4.text: I am the last door. I will not open.

sentinel_death.text: The seal... is yours to keep.

sovereign2_p2.text: Kneel, and burn with my kingdom!

sovereign2_p3.text: Ash is all that kneels before me!

sovereign2_p4.text: Witness the crown of the sun!

sovereign2_death.text: My fire... was never meant to fade.

empress_p2.text: Winter does not end. It waits.

empress_p3.text: Be still. Be silent. Be frozen.

empress_p4.text: A thousand years of snow... fall now!

saint_p2.text: The garden remembers what you broke.

saint_p3.text: Root and thorn, take back the grove.

saint_p4.text: I have no name. Only the grove.

varkhazan_p2.text: The sky is my grave, and yours.

varkhazan_p3.text: Hear the storm that buried my kin!

varkhazan_p4.text: The sky tears open at my command!

worldeater0_p2.text: Do you feel it? Gravity is failing.

worldeater0_p4.text: I am only its shadow. Imagine the rest.

fallenstar_p4.text: Burn in the last light of a dying star!

eternalnight_p2.text: Close your eyes. It makes no difference.

hollowking_p4.text: A king without mercy needs no crown!

hollowking_death.text: Take the crown. It was always too heavy.

worldeater_p2.text: Worlds are only bread to me.

worldeater_p3.text: Gravity bends. The stars go dark.

worldeater_death.text: Then... let it all begin again.
